2. Impacts
a. Comparative Energy Efficiency
Both rail and bus modes are approximately three times more energy-efficient from an operational standpoint than the automobile (See Figure IV. 19).
Although there would be little difference between rail and bus modes from the standpoint of energy-efficiency, rail alternatives (I-V) present the greatest opportunity to reduce petroleum consumption through utilization of non-petroleum power sources, such as coal, hydropower, geothermal and nuclear. They also offer the potential of doubling their carrying capacity with comparatively little capital cost - simply by shortening headways and adding more cars which would further reduce auto trips and therefore conserve energy.
